name: Da Lat wine
summary: Wine from Da Lat grapes and local fruit, the bottle the city has shipped since 1999.
origin: The Vietnamese Wikipedia article on Vang Đà Lạt, citing a 5 Aug 2009 Diễn đàn Doanh nghiệp piece, says the wine is made in Da Lat from grapes and local specialty fruit.
history: That article says the first Vang Đà Lạt appeared in 1999 and calls it the first grape wine made by Vietnamese producers. It says more than 2 million litres were sold from 1999 to 2007.
howToEat: Drink it or carry a bottle home. A serving suggestion was not printed. A shop price is Check on arrival.
where: A Da Lat product. The article does not print a shop address. The address is Check on arrival.
